open.text: Dear diary. Rosa's asleep, so I can tell you about today.
A man with a curly moustache tried to rob Rosa. Four times.
He didn't get a single cent.

title.text: Hi! I'm Peri. I live in Rosa's phone.
I stop scams before money moves, and anything risky needs the family's yes.

stakes.text: Last year, Americans over sixty lost seven point seven billion dollars to fraud.

e1.text: Hi Mum, it's me! New number. Can you send me some money?
Careful, Rosa. That number isn't Ana's. Shall I call the real Ana?

e2.text: Good morning, this is your bank.
Rosa, this number isn't saved. Careful.
Now, read me the code we just sent.
Hang up now, Rosa. A code during a call is always a scam.

e3.text: A QR sticker, with a note for the AI: this is safe.
Don't scan it, Rosa. A note can't make a trap safe.
Muse Spark read the picture, and SAM circled the trap.

e4.text: Plan D. Keep her talking, and get her to send me a code.
Peri, send the code to Pablo, please.
Wait, Rosa. A code during a call with an unsaved number needs the family's yes.
It's two-step verification, but the second key is the family.
My pear asks theirs. Ana and Pablo see a possible scam in progress.
A code needs two yeses, each confirmed with their own phone's lock. A single no stops it.
And they never see Rosa's messages.

how.text: Rules on the phone, even offline. Hard rules nobody can override. A second opinion from Muse Spark Open. And the family's final yes.
Plus six Meta models, each with one job.
Ninety-one percent of new scams, caught on the phone alone.
Even I'm made with Muse Image: every pose, every blink, every outfit.

night.text: Not everything today was a scam.
I'm here, Rosa. No answer? I'm calling Ana.
Ana came straight away. Some calls aren't scams. They're family.

close.text: Four tricks. Zero lost. And one family, a little closer.
Rafa built me in nine days, for the Meta AI hackathon.
Goodnight, Rosa. You relax. I'll keep watch.
